title: Hogganaa Saba tokkoo Muudame
intro: Yeroo qormaata guddaa fi abdii kutannaa ummata tokkoof muudamni waaqummaatu murtaa’e. Namni dhuunfaa kun jalqaba irratti namoota hedduu biratti kan bira darbame yoo ta’u, saba tokko mormituu sodaachisaa irratti akka geggeessuuf Rabbiin filate. Seenaan isaanii humna amantii fi ogummaa labsii waaqaa duuba jiruuf ragaadha, hoggansi dhugaa yeroo hunda bakka eegamutti akka hin argamne agarsiisa.
clues: Uummatni kootiif hogganaa akkan ta’uuf Rabbiin filadhe, gaafa isaan bulchaa karaa Isaa irratti qabsaa’u barbaadan.
Sabni koo jalqaba irratti muudama koo irratti gaaffii kaasan, qabeenya ykn hidda dhaloota isaanii irraa kan ka’e warri kaan caalaatti akka malu itti dhaga’ame.
Mallattoon hoggansa koo isa sirrii ta’e, saanduqa qulqulluun, hambaalee raajota duraanii of keessaa qabu deebi’uu isaati, kunis tasgabbii fide.
Waraana koo gara laga tokkootti kanan geesse siʼa taʼu, achitti bishaan qodaa tokkoo ol akka hin dhugne dhorkuudhaan ajajamuu isaanii qoradhe.
Warri qormaata booda jabaatanii hafan lakkoofsi isaanii xiqqaa ta’us, loltuu jabaa fi waraana isaanii nu mudate.
Ajaja koo jalatti dargaggeessi dhuunfaa waraana koo keessaa, qabsaa’aa beekamaa hin taane, shaampiyoonaa diinaa sodaachisaa kana gootummaan wal dura dhaabbatee injifate.

trial.label: Yaali/Taatee
options: Muudamni akka hogganaa tokkootti nama guddaa tokko irratti
trial.answer: Muudamni akka hogganaa tokkootti nama guddaa tokko irratti

outcome.label: Bu'aa
options: Mootummaan qabeenyaafi aangoo hammana hin jedhamneen hundeeffame.
Shaampiyoonni diinaa injifatamee, Rabbiin injifannoo kenne.
Gogiinsi guddaan waggootaaf lafa sana dhiphise.
Hogganaan sun uumama guddaa tokkoon liqimfame.
outcome.answer: Shaampiyoonni diinaa injifatamee, Rabbiin injifannoo kenne.

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
